name: vpo
character: Virtual Playing Orchestra 3.3: a free orchestra in SFZ built from the best free sample sets, with solo and section patches, key-switch patches and a mod-wheel performance variant
licence: Mixed Creative Commons (CC Sampling Plus 1.0, CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0, CC0) per source set; the author states no restriction on music made with it and asks that the library is not repackaged or sold
attribution: Virtual Playing Orchestra, Paul Battersby, virtualplaying.com (samples from Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra, No Budget Orchestra, VSCO 2 Community Edition, University of Iowa, Philharmonia Orchestra)

scripts_standard.what: SFZ scripts, key velocity = loudness, articulations as patches or key-switches

scripts_performance.what: SFZ scripts, mod wheel = loudness, velocity picks the articulation

wave.what: the wave files (libs/ folder); required by both script sets
wave.manual_note: The author hosts these on OneDrive, which refuses scripted downloads. Open the page, download 'Wave Files (603 MB)', then run: sfz_libs.py install-local vpo <downloaded.zip> --project <dir>

notes: Needs BOTH the wave files and one script set, unpacked into the same folder. Author: 'REVERB IS ESSENTIAL'. All sustain samples are looped.
